annotations.title: Find published controls about one concern

description: Which published security controls cover this? Give one of six concerns -- encryption at rest, audit logging, session timeout, key rotation, access review, backup -- and get the provisions whose own text speaks to it, from all five published documents (NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5, NIST SP 800-171 Rev 3, the NIST Secure Software Development Framework and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0), each with its citation and the publisher's verbatim passage. A document we hold but may not reproduce as a list is named in documents_withheld with the reason, so its absence is never read as silence: the HIPAA Security Rule is there today. The match is a literal phrase search over the published text, and every result names the phrase it matched and where it matched (control title or requirement text), so the selection can be checked rather than trusted. This is a search over what the publishers wrote, not an opinion about what your system needs.

concern.description: One of the six concerns listed.

framework.description: Optional. Limit the answer to one document: "nist" for NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5, "nist-800-171" for NIST SP 800-171 Rev 3, "ssdf" for NIST SP 800-218, "csf" for the NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0, "hipaa" for the HIPAA Security Rule.
